newsitem.title: UK: BAA names Speakman cargo general manager.
newsitem.headline: BAA names Speakman cargo general manager.

text.p: BAA Plc said it has appointed John Speakman as general manager cargo, with effect from September 1.
He joined BAA five years ago and until recently was property director of BAA-owned and operated London Stansted airport, where he was responsible for cargo.
Speakman will succeed BAA head of cargo development Ian Robinson, who announced last month he would be taking early retirement from BAA after 14 years' service to pursue a career in aviation.
BAA said the new position gives Speakman responsibility for cargo across the BAA group.
"His role will focus on communication with the cargo community and the development of cargo business for the group and cargo operators," said BAA in a statement.
